page_title: VAL 1-2 BAR | Valencia v Barcelona 17/08/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+8' Jose Sanchez is looking at his watch and immediately ends this match.
90+8' Raphinha (Barcelona) decides to take a short corner instead of crossing into the box.

90+8' Raphinha (Barcelona) sends a pass into the box, but the opposition's defence is alert to the danger and makes a clearance. The ball goes out for a corner. Barcelona can continue in their attacking effort.
90+4' Robert Lewandowski (Barcelona) latches on to an accurate pass inside the box and immediately unleashes a shot towards goal, but it goes high over the crossbar.
90+3' Barcelona work the corner short. The ball is passed to a nearby teammate.
90+2' Pau Victor (Barcelona) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge. The referee blows his whistle, Barcelona are awarded a corner kick.
90+1' Golden chance! Marc Casado (Barcelona) meets a cross in the box and finds some space for a shot. He produces an inaccurate effort that goes wide of the right post.
90' The fourth official shows 6 min. of added time.
89' The free kick is delivered by Pepelu (Valencia) but it's not one of his best and is easily cleared.
89' It looks like Inigo Martinez (Barcelona) saw red with that tackle. Jose Sanchez won't tolerate such behaviour on the pitch and blows for a foul. A free kick is awarded to Valencia.
88' A player from Barcelona commits a rough challenge. Jose Sanchez blows for a foul and keeps the game under control.
86' Hansi Flick has decided to make a change. Pau Victor (Barcelona) replaces Lamine Yamal.
86' Substitution. Hugo Guillamon (Valencia) in, Javi Guerra out.

85' What an opportunity! Pedri (Barcelona) picked the ball up and fired a projectile of a shot from long range which threatened the goalkeeper. The shot went painfully close to the left post! The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Valencia.
84' Pedri (Barcelona) gets in a good position inside the box and is only inches away from getting on the end of a through ball from the edge of the area.
81' Today's referee Jose Sanchez rightly decides to book Jules Kounde (Barcelona) for his harsh tackle.
80' Flag goes up against Dani Gomez (Valencia) and the referee blows his whistle for offside.
79' Shots on target – 1:8.
77' Ruben Baraja has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Martin Tejon (Valencia) replacing Jesus Vazquez.
77' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and David Otorbi (Valencia) comes onto the pitch for Rafa Mir.
76' The referee blows his whistle and players are going to refresh themselves.
74' The resulting set piece, sent into the penalty area by Raphinha (Barcelona), was easily dealt with by one of the defenders.
74' Dani Gomez (Valencia) was too forceful with his tackle and Jose Sanchez interrupted the game to signal a free kick. Barcelona have a free kick.
72' The corner is swung in but Barcelona can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.
71' Barcelona can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield. Barcelona force a corner. They send men into the box.
71' That will be all from Marc Bernal who is being replaced by the fresh legs of Eric Garcia (Barcelona).

71' A defender unwittingly blocks the ball on the line after a snap shot from Robert Lewandowski (Barcelona) inside the box following a slide rule pass. The ball is out of play. Barcelona win a corner kick.
69' Jose Sanchez shows a yellow card to Andreas Christensen (Barcelona), who isn't surprised as the tackle was really hard and late.
68' Barcelona take a short corner instead of sending the ball into the penalty area.
67' Jules Kounde (Barcelona) produces a quality cross into the box, but the opposition's defence intercepts the ball and spanks it away. Barcelona will take a corner kick.
66' Here is a change. Diego Lopez is going off and Ruben Baraja gives the last tactical orders to Dimitri Foulquier (Valencia).
66' The referee signals a substitution. Dani Gomez (Valencia) is brought on as a substitute for Andre Almeida.
65' The resulting set piece from Valencia is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.
65' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Valencia. Valencia have been awarded a corner kick.
64' Substitution. Ferran Torres makes his way off the pitch and Pedri (Barcelona) comes on as his replacement.
64' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Andreas Christensen (Barcelona) replaces Pau Cubarsi.
64' Hansi Flick is forced to make a change. Alejandro Balde is unable to continue due to injury, Gerard Martin (Barcelona) comes on.
61' Alejandro Balde (Barcelona) is down injured and the referee stops play so that he can receive medical treatment.
58' Ferran Torres (Barcelona) darts into the penalty area to latch on to a pass, and he unleashes a low drive towards the middle of the net, but Giorgi Mamardashvili is alert and denies him.
57' Ruben Baraja isn't happy on the touchline after referee Jose Sanchez shows him a yellow card.
56' Jose Sanchez has a clear sight and sees a foul from Pau Cubarsi (Barcelona).
55' Barcelona keep the ball and are displaying some tiki-taka style passing at the moment.
52' Thierry Correia (Valencia) fails to pick a body out in the box with an over-hit cross to the back post.
51' Jose Sanchez blows his whistle. Robert Lewandowski (Barcelona) commits a foul after dangerous play.
49' 1 - 2 Goal! Robert Lewandowski (Barcelona) wins the battle of wills and sends an unstoppable penalty past Giorgi Mamardashvili into the top right corner.
49' Robert Lewandowski (Barcelona) is heading towards the penalty spot to take it.
48' Jose Sanchez blows his whistle and signals a foul after Cristhian Mosquera (Valencia) brought his opponent down. The referee's verdict is crystal clear. A penalty is awarded to Barcelona!
46' Lamine Yamal (Barcelona) has a great chance inside the six-yard box, shoots low to the middle of the goal, but Giorgi Mamardashvili pulls off an exquisite save to deny him.
46' Everything is set for the start of the second half.
45+7' That is it for the first half after the referee blows his whistle and the players head to their respective dressing rooms.
45+5' 1 - 1 Robert Lewandowski (Barcelona) receives the ball inside the box, reacts quickly and without any problems fires the ball into the back of the net.
45+5' Jose Sanchez shows the yellow card to Jesus Vazquez (Valencia) for a heavy challenge.
45+2' Marc Casado (Barcelona) picks up a pass inside the box and finds some space for a shot before unleashing a low drive goalwards, but one of the defending players blocks his effort.
45+2' Jose Sanchez shows a yellow card to Pau Cubarsi (Barcelona) for a tough tackle.
45' 5 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
44' 1 - 0 It's a goal! Diego Lopez sends a long raking pass onto the head of Hugo Duro (Valencia), who makes no mistake from close in and sends the ball into the left side of the goal. 1:0.
44' The assistant referee raises his flag and the referee blows his whistle. Hugo Duro (Valencia) puts the ball into the net, but he is flagged for offside.
44' That looked like an offside in the build-up play and the referee Jose Sanchez is going to take a look using VAR.
44' Valencia are bossing possession at the moment by exchanging some precise passes from player to player.
41' The linesman raises his flag as one of the players from Valencia was in an offside position.
39' The defensive wall does its job and blocks the mid-range attempt from the free-kick by Raphinha (Barcelona).
38' Pepelu (Valencia) sees a yellow card from Jose Sanchez after he sent one of the opposing players to the ground.
38' Referee Jose Sanchez sees the trip by Pepelu (Valencia) and doesn't hesitate to blow his whistle. Barcelona are awarded the free kick.
38' Diego Lopez (Valencia) makes an overly-aggressive challenge and Jose Sanchez blows his whistle for a foul.
35' Raphinha (Barcelona) dinks a cross into the box in an attempt to find one of his teammates, but the defence manages to clear.
34' Raphinha (Barcelona) rolls the ball short to a teammate from the corner instead of sending a cross into the box.

34' Robert Lewandowski (Barcelona) attempts to find one of his teammates with a sweet pass into the box, but one of the defending players reacts well and intercepts the effort. Barcelona force a corner. Their opponents will face another attacking threat.
34' A quickly taken corner by Barcelona.
34' A cross into the box from Alejandro Balde (Barcelona) is cleared. Barcelona have been awarded a corner kick. The referee and one of his assistants both point at the corner flag.
30' The ref blows his whistle and we are going to have a so-called cooling break due to the high temperature.
29' Barcelona players are exchanging short passes with one another, waiting for the right moment to beat the opposition's defence.

28' Pau Cubarsi (Barcelona) reacts well and displays good awareness near the penalty spot to get on the end of a cross from the free kick. He jumps high and produces a header which goes well over the crossbar.
27' Jesus Vazquez (Valencia) commits a rough foul. Jose Sanchez stops the game and makes a call. There is a free kick near the sideline to Barcelona.
26' Alejandro Balde (Barcelona) hasn't suffered any serious injury which would see him leave the pitch. He's back in the game now.
26' Jules Kounde (Barcelona) is penalised after knocking an opponent down.
24' Alejandro Balde (Barcelona) is clearly asking for some medical attention with his painful gestures. The extent of his injury is yet to be discovered.
23' Jose Sanchez blows for a foul after Marc Casado (Barcelona) was too aggressive in the battle for the ball.
21' The game is pretty dull as Barcelona are just passing the ball from player to player. Nothing lasts forever, though, and they finally make a mistake, allowing the opposition to pick up the ball.
19' Ferran Torres (Barcelona) tries to send a pass but it's blocked.

19' Raphinha (Barcelona) gets into a good scoring position. He creates some space for himself and tries his luck from distance. His decent effort towards the right post is, however, superbly saved by Giorgi Mamardashvili!
17' Jesus Vazquez (Valencia) is adjudged to have been offside when making his run.

15' Hugo Duro (Valencia) reacts well and displays good awareness inside the box to get on the end of the resulting corner kick. He fails to direct the ball into the net as it flies narrowly over the crossbar.
14' Pepelu (Valencia) prepares to take a corner kick.
14' Andre Almeida (Valencia) tries to send the ball in front of the goal, but the opposition's defence averts the threat. It will be a corner kick for Valencia.
12' Hugo Duro (Valencia) attempted to create a dangerous situation in front of goal by sending a cross into the box, but the defence easily dealt with the threat.
11' Barcelona players are playing combination football and attempting to create a goal-scoring opportunity, but they will have to wait for that as they have just lost possession due to a poor pass.
10' Andre Almeida (Valencia) is caught offside!

7' Alejandro Balde (Barcelona) gets into a good scoring position. He creates some space for himself and tries his luck from distance. His decent effort towards the middle of the goal is, however, saved by Giorgi Mamardashvili!
6' Barcelona have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.

6' Fantastic run and shot from mid-range by Lamine Yamal (Barcelona), but a defender denies him an almost certain goal by getting his body in the way. Barcelona force their opponents to concede a corner.
5' A spell of possession for Barcelona in an attempt to control the game.
2' Barcelona are ruled offside.
2' The linesman raises his flag. Rafa Mir (Valencia) is adjudged offside.
1' The first half of this match is about to start.
Valencia will kick the game off.
Jose Sanchez will officiate today.
